data.long_meaning: The meaning of Rodrick is recorded in name-lists as “Ruler of the rods”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rodrick expresses “Ruler of the rods”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rodrick total 42, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
